title: 120兆瓦刚交付：远景为何敢喊，5到10吉瓦
speaker: Ricky Jung

segments.en: Give us an update. Have you guys started construction? How has it gone? Yeah, hi guys. Yeah, good morning. So yeah, we are happy to announce that we officially deliver our phase one 120 megawatt IT loads to our end user, the off-taker.
segments.zh: 给大家更新一下。你们开始建设了吗？进展如何？大家好，早上好。我们很高兴宣布，已正式向终端用户交付一期120兆瓦的IT负载。

segments.en: And we also have our wind farm starting generating power and provide around like 80% of the annual consumption to our data center.
segments.zh: 我们的风电场也开始发电，每年可满足数据中心约80%的用电需求。

segments.en: So we are also continuously working on the phase two to three, the whole park will be around two to three gigawatt in total.
segments.zh: 我们也在持续推进二、三期，整个园区总规模将达到2至3吉瓦。

segments.en: And so we are about to finish that by the end of 2028. So yeah, it's a very big and fast growing places in Ulaamkab or in whole in Mongolia.
segments.zh: 我们计划在2028年底前完成。所以，这在乌兰巴托乃至整个蒙古都是一个非常庞大且快速发展的项目。

segments.en: We are expecting we grow much faster than now. Yeah, here's what we currently do.
segments.zh: 我们预计增长速度会比现在快得多。这就是我们目前在做的事情。

segments.en: Can you tell us what's unique about inner Mongolia itself, right? We talked about the ample amount of wind, solar energy in that front of me.
segments.zh: 您能谈谈内蒙古本身的独特之处吗？我们之前提到过那里有丰富的风能和太阳能。

segments.en: Is this a model that can only happen in a region like this or is it something that you could actually export somewhere else in the world?
segments.zh: 这种模式是否只能在这样的地区实现，还是可以推广到世界其他地方？

segments.en: Yeah, yeah, definitely in Mongolia will be the very ideal place to first move for the first step.
segments.zh: 是的，蒙古无疑是迈出第一步的理想之地。

segments.en: But actually, we recently launched a plan called Mission Gobi, which we were about to build like 5 to 10 gigawatts, the AI data center all over the world.
segments.zh: 但事实上，我们最近启动了一项名为“戈壁使命”的计划，准备在全球建设5至10吉瓦的AI数据中心。

segments.en: The Gobi Desert means that the place which abundance renewable energy supplies. So yeah, we put in Mongolia and Ulaamkab as our demonstration and the pilot case.
segments.zh: 戈壁沙漠意味着可再生能源供应丰富的地方。因此，我们将蒙古和乌兰巴托作为示范和试点案例。
